reviews.text:
The 4.3 rating on google is extremely un reliable check yelp where they have a 1.9 rating which seems more accurate for how terrible this place is I’m surprised they’re still open.

My 10-month-old dog was groomed here on May 30 from approximately 8:30 AM to 3:30 PM. She walked into her appointment without any issues and left unable to put weight on one of her legs.

What makes this situation even more concerning is that I was told staff noticed an issue with her leg before they even gave her a bath. However, no one contacted me before proceeding with the grooming service.

Later, it was suggested that I failed to mention an injury at drop-off. The problem with that claim is simple: there was no injury to report. My dog was not limping, favoring a leg, or refusing to bear weight when I brought her in. If staff genuinely believed she arrived injured, why continue handling her and complete the grooming appointment without first notifying me?

There was also initial confusion when the issue was discussed because I thought they were referring to a minor foot pad scrape she occasionally gets from chasing squirrels. Once we clarified that was not what they meant, I clearly stated that she did not arrive with a leg injury.

I was further told that the injury may have been related to how she was handled during grooming and that footage would be reviewed because she did not walk into the facility with this injury, yet she left with one.

It is now Sunday, and my dog is still refusing to bear weight on her leg. This was her first grooming appointment, and she is only 10 months old. I am heartbroken, furious, and extremely disappointed with both the injury itself and the way this situation has been handled.

A healthy puppy was entrusted to their care. An injured puppy was returned to me.

Update they showed me the video when I took my dog versus when I picked my dog up and you can clearly see that they were At fault, my dog walked in perfectly fine and walked out with a Dislocated hip, they refused to reimburse me for my medical bill for my pet. They refuse to acknowledge the video for what it was. It continued to put blame that I would bring my dog somewhere injured. They Acknowledge that they did not do the correct protocol was still refused to take full accountability for their actions. This place completely neglected my dog and neglected to inform me of her injuries prior to her grooming if there were any. Which is what they Claimed. You can also clearly hear in the video of me picking my dog The woman saying that it was probably how they miss handled her during the groom and that she might be sore so they acknowledge that it might be their fault but then refuse to take accountability for it actually being their fault once I came with the bill for reimbursement

Gave my dog fleas twice; i suspected they gave her fleas the first time, but i have been a customer for years, so i didn’t want to believe it was true. I completely cleared her of fleas & brought her back maybe 3 months later free of fleas to be sure& now they are back a week  after her visit here. Any regulars check your puppies for scabs or dark spots from healed bites. This outbreak has been going on for at least 6 months they are aware, or at least should notice it on the dogs at this point

A few days ago, as usual, I called to see if they could give my dog ​​a full service. They said yes. When I introduced him, they told me the cost was $70, and I got upset because every time I take him, the price goes up, and they don't even do the full service. My dog ​​is very nervous and already old. The woman who answered was very rude and unethical, telling me she didn't want to do the service because he bites (my dog ​​doesn't have teeth). She said this just because I asked why the price keeps going up each time I take him. I think people who do this kind of work do it more out of love and devotion. As a customer since they opened their grooming salon, even though I haven't always been happy with their work, I don't deserve this treatment. I hope they become more aware and value their customers more, because without customers, there's no work.

0 Stars they fool you like they are professional but it’s all an act I took my dog here twice which was my mistake I admit. The first time I took him there they nipped him pretty bad told me that they couldn’t compensate me for it the only thing they could do was pay hospital bills if it had gotten worst. Which It did not get worst but it did traumatize my dog really bad it was his first time ever getting groomed and he hates it. Now I still tried to give them the benefit of doubt that it was just a mistake. But the second time was even worst than the first time , I dropped my dog off around 10:30am called to see what time they would be done they told me around 4:30pm-5pm. I told them that’s unacceptable I need my dog back sooner than that I had other things to do. I didn’t end up getting my dog back until 3:30pm and was told that they had almost 15dogs ahead of my dog which I was not notified of at all at drop off. MOST IMPORTANTLY I PICKED MY DOG UP AND NOTICED THAT HE DOES’NT WANT TO BE TOUCHED ON HIS HEAD WHICH WAS VERY ODD BECAUSE THATS HIS FAVORITE SPOT FOR ME TO RUB . I NOTICED THAT HE IS VERY TENDER AND SENSITIVE RIGHT THERE LIKE HE COULD'VE BEEN DROPPED OR HIT WITH SOMETHING HE IS REALLY SORE STILL, AND IT HAS BEEN 4 DAYS SINCE THEN. I don’t know what they have done to him but it’s completely unacceptable and unprofessional to treat someone’s pet like so. This is your sign to not do business with them. I never leave reviews but the way my dog was treated breaks my heart.

Biggest scammers and ungrateful business! I’ve been bringing my dog here for years and paying $60 for a small dog. All of a sudden he’s a medium dog and it’s $70. I show my $60 zelle payments for the last 3 years and this broom girl tells me they’ve been charging me wrong. It’s $70 or take your dog elsewhere. Thank you, I gladly will!

100% DO NOT RECOMMEND. Although lady at front desk was very nice & professional AT FIRST. I brought my dog in for an appointment around 11 AM & was told it might take a few hours to groom as he had some matting in which as a pet owner I will admit he did which I completely understand it takes time. I called around 1:40 pm, as they do close at 3 pm to see the status of my pup & was told “they were barely starting on him right now.” I get a call at exactly 2:55 pm stating “they were able to bath him & dry him but he was being extremely aggressive & not allowing them to trim his hair or do anything else.” MIND YOU, my dog has went to the groomers plenty of times, specially PETSMART, in which they have always done an amazing job with grooming & handling our pup. At that they have always said he was very well behaved & didn’t give a hard time. My dog has never bitten a soul nor been aggressive & those who KNOW this breed will also agree. I was already waiting outside for my pup & so I go in, I was baffled by what I seen. The women brings my dog & first thing I notice is a burn mark on his nose & patches in his fur. As she passes my dog she proceeds to tell me that his nose looked that way because they had to put a muzzle due to him being aggressive & he was trying to bite & scratch it off. Then he had marks by his eyes, that was apparently from him “banging his head into the wall as they were trying to dry him.” As I’m looking at the fur, I noticed patches as if they were being careless with pulling his hair as matts were hanging off in certain places. The lady proceeds to ask if my dog has ever been to a groomer. REALISTICALLY speaking if you are familiar with  poodles, you would know if he has not been to see a groomer in his four years of living, he would look 10 times worse than the picture I am going to leave below. I am extremely angry with the staff & awareness of this facility. One more thing that was noticed as I was dropping my pup off, the other dogs that were in cages seemed extremely upset & afraid as they had two other pups there that would not stop barking or ACTUALLY being aggressive. This is no way to treat a fur baby AT ALL. SO DISGUSTED & DISAPPOINTED. By the way, I was still charged $60 for just a bath & SEMI dry ( no teeth cleaning, ear cleaning, ect. were done) This is a SHAME!
